rationale: Definition of foreign architect is useful and not the same intent as existing permit/reciprocity items.

proposed_question.code_citation: RA 9266 IRR, Section 3, Item 30, PDF p.5.
proposed_question.text: Under the RA 9266 IRR, which description best matches a foreign architect?

rationale.correct: Section 3, Item 30 defines the foreign architect by non-Filipino/non-Philippine licensure status plus home-country architectural licensure.

distractors.A: Foreign ownership of the firm is not the definition.
distractors.C: Studying abroad does not make a Philippine RLA a foreign architect under this definition.
distractors.D: The contractor relationship is not the statutory definition.

rationale.takeaway: The definition turns on citizenship, Philippine registration/licensure, and home-country licensure.

proposed_question.explanation: RA 9266 IRR, Section 3, Item 30, PDF p.5.

options.text: A Filipino architect working for a foreign-owned firm
An architect not Filipino and not registered and licensed in the Philippines, but licensed in the home country
Any architect who studied abroad but holds a Philippine PRC card
A contractor who hires a foreign design consultant
